description.value: Pappa Leo's Pizza is a locally-founded Lower Mainland chain started in 2003 by two brothers, now spanning 7 locations including this Barnet Highway outpost — one of two in Coquitlam. The kitchen makes dough fresh daily and sources quality toppings, earning multiple best-pizza awards across the region. Touring cyclists will find a full pizza menu plus sides like wings, lasagna, and Caesar salad, with gluten-free crust on offer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's locations page explicitly confirms the Barnet Highway Coquitlam location with matching phone (604-552-3366) and address (#9-2565 Barnet Hwy, Coquitlam, BC V3H 4E2), validating OSM contact data. The site title 'Takeouts & Delivery' and repeated 'Order Online' and delivery references confirm takeout service; the about/menu pages confirm gluten-free crust availability. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pizza restaurant confirmed open via website with matching address and phone. A practical meal stop for cyclists on the Barnet Highway corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly states 'We also offer gluten free pizza crust options.'
